title: review board sidecar
description: One board's sidecar.json; generated from src/cplugs/reviewboard/schema.py, do not edit.

Actor.description: Who made a board or a revision. Fields: actor; session (the app session id, when known); label (its name).
Actor.title: Actor

Anchor.description: A named element of the mockup (``data-rb-anchor="<id>"``) Joe may pin a note to.
Anchor.title: Anchor

AnchorNote.description: A note Joe pinned to a declared anchor.
AnchorNote.title: AnchorNote

Answer.description: Joe's answer to one prompt: ``options`` (choice, multi), ``checked`` (check) or ``text`` (question), plus a note.
Answer.title: Answer

Board.description: The board itself. ``slug`` equals its folder name; ``kind`` is display only.
Board.title: Board

ChoiceItem.description: Pick one of ``options``; the payload value is the option id.
ChoiceItem.title: ChoiceItem

DateItem.description: A calendar day, ``YYYY-MM-DD``, optionally bounded by ``min`` and ``max``.
DateItem.title: DateItem

Delivery.description: How the round reached its task: ``pending``, ``posted`` (item and message) or ``undelivered`` (with a reason).
Delivery.title: Delivery

ExtBlock.description: One extension's block under ``ext``: a version ``v`` and anything else the extension keeps (kept as written).
ExtBlock.title: ExtBlock

LayerOption.description: One option of a ``choice``, ``multi`` or ``rank`` item.
LayerOption.title: LayerOption

MultiItem.description: Pick several of ``options`` (``min`` and ``max`` bound the count); the payload value is the list of option ids.
MultiItem.title: MultiItem

NumberItem.description: A number in ``min``..``max`` (a slider needs both bounds); ``unit`` is only shown.
NumberItem.title: NumberItem

Option.description: One option of a ``choice`` or ``multi`` prompt.
Option.title: Option

PayloadDiff.description:
What a send changed against the previous send, by dotted path: ``added``, ``removed``, ``changed`` (each at most
``MAX_DIFF_PATHS``; ``more`` counts the paths left out). ``previous`` names that earlier round; absent on the first send.
PayloadDiff.title: PayloadDiff

PayloadDraft.description:
A payload page's working state (#1760): ONE draft per revision, overwritten in place by the board's autosave, never numbered. A
numbered ``Save`` is a milestone Joe's Send makes; the draft is only where the page's latest state survives a reload.
PayloadDraft.title: PayloadDraft

Prompt.description: Something the revision asks Joe: ``choice`` (one option), ``multi`` (any), ``check`` (one box), ``question`` (text).
Prompt.title: Prompt

QuestionsLayer.description: The questions layer: at most 60 items; the payload is ``{layer: "questions", v: 1, values: {item id: value}, notes: {item id: text}}``.
QuestionsLayer.title: QuestionsLayer

RankItem.description: Drag (or press up and down) to order ``options``; the payload value is EVERY option id in Joe's order.
RankItem.title: RankItem

Revision.description:
One revision: immutable once written. ``answers_round`` names the round it answers, if any.

``payload_mode`` (#1760) says the page owns its controls and posts a payload; ``saves`` are the numbered saves of that payload, appended
by the board's one writer. ``draft`` is the one overwriting autosave of the page's latest state (not a save, not counted against
``MAX_SAVES``). ``max_width`` (px, optional) holds a canvas page to that width, centered; absent means full width. ``layer`` (#1832) names the prebuilt layer (questions or rows) the board draws over the page; it implies ``payload_mode``.
The page file and the rest of the row never change; saves and the draft are not revisions.
Revision.title: Revision

Round.description:
One send of Joe's review on one revision. History: never rewritten, Joe's words stored as typed.

A payload send (#1760) carries ``payload`` (the state sent), ``save`` (the number of the save the send made on its revision) and ``diff``
(against the previous send); its ``answers`` and ``anchor_notes`` are empty.
Round.title: Round

RoundContext.description: What Joe was looking at when he sent: theme, frame width, fit mode, view (each unknown for a converted round).
RoundContext.title: RoundContext

Row.description: One row to review. ``suggest`` is the agent's take (a choice id), shown and NEVER pre-picked; ``default`` is a carried pick the agent embeds.
Row.title: Row

RowChoice.description: One pick a row may take. ``tone`` (``ok``, ``push``, ``later``, ``none``) only picks the token its chip is painted with.
RowChoice.title: RowChoice

RowLine.description: One labeled line of a row (``you had``, ``now``, ``my take``), plain text.
RowLine.title: RowLine

RowsLayer.description:
The review-rows layer: at most 200 rows, each picking from ``choices`` (the layer's, or its own); ``pick`` says one or several.

The payload is ``{layer: "rows", v: 1, values: {row id: pick id, or a list of ids when pick is several}, notes: {row id: text}}``.
RowsLayer.title: RowsLayer

Save.description: One numbered save of a payload page's state (#1760): every save is kept, Joe steps back through them. Not a revision.
Save.title: Save

TaskLink.description: THE ONE task rounds go to. ``computer`` owns the item (ids are per machine); ``github_issue`` is portable.
TaskLink.title: TaskLink

TaskLinkChange.description: One relink (or correction) of the board's task, kept forever. ``from`` is the item it was linked to before.
TaskLinkChange.title: TaskLinkChange

TextItem.description: A short line of text (at most 300 characters).
TextItem.title: TextItem

ToggleItem.description: An on or off switch; ``false`` unless a default says otherwise.
ToggleItem.title: ToggleItem

View.description: One page of a revision: its file, and the sha256 and byte count of the file as written (immutable).
View.title: View

YesNoItem.description: A tri-state yes or no: absent from the payload is unanswered. Has no default.
YesNoItem.title: YesNoItem
